description: This file defines the 'ContentWriter' class, which provides methods to write data streams for PDF content. It handles writing raw strings, characters, and managing indentation, specifically designed for generating PDF streams within the PdfSharp library.

classes.name: ContentWriter
classes.description: A class responsible for writing PDF content streams, managing stream position, indentation, and raw data writing operations.

methods.name: ContentWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the ContentWriter with a given stream.

methods.name: Close
methods.description: Closes the underlying stream, optionally closing the stream resource.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Placeholder method for writing boolean values to the stream (currently not implemented).

methods.name: WriteRaw
methods.description: Writes a raw string to the PDF stream, encoding it into bytes.

methods.name: WriteLineRaw
methods.description: Writes a raw string followed by a newline character.

methods.name: WriteRaw(char)
methods.description: Writes a single character as a byte to the stream.

methods.name: GetCategory
methods.description: Determines the category of a character (e.g., delimiter or character).
